questions.qtext:
Consider the energy band diagram of an ideal MOS-capacitor shown below:

 
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding the above given MOS capacitor?

options.text: The applied potential at gate terminal is positive.
The substrate used in MOS-capacitor is of n-type.
The potential drop across oxide layer is more than semiconductor substrate.

questions.solution:
(a, d)
In the given energy band diagram, since the fermi level is closer to the valence band, hence the semiconductor substrate is of p-type. Also at the oxide semiconductor interface, Ei – EF is more, hence more number of holes are accumulated at interface. Thus, MOS capacitor is in accumulation mode.
